title: Lester Young and his nicknames
summary: Pres loved his own playing but respected Hawkins, and he named Basie Holy, Edison Sweets, Billie Lady Day and others.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Well, tell us some things about Lester. What was that --
Oh, Lester. He didn't like nobody's playing but his. He loved his playing. He respected Coleman
Hawkins, give him all the respect in the world. He respected Chu Berry, he respected Joe Thomas. But he liked his playing. He liked his playing.
And everything he did was a classic. Like he had names for different people. He nicknamed Basie, "Holy," the Holy Man, because he was the leader.

The main man, yes, the main man, you see. He named him Holy because he did the paying off, he was the bandleader. And he named me "Sweets." He named Billie Holiday "Lady Day." He named himself "Pres."
Oh, I thought Billie's supposed to have done that.

Well, yeah, he's "the President." Used to call himself the president, so she shortened it to "Pres." And he named Earl Warren "Smiley." Oh, he had a name for everybody. He named Herschel "Tex," you know, because he was from Texas. Of course, everybody from Texas -- he had a knack for doing so many things that were comical in the band.
